representative_scale.scale_policy: One fixed scale from brief; no scale search or doubling.

outputs.full_energy_series_output_reason: Brief driver does not serialize individual samples.

timing_scope.ensemble: perf_counter from before first replica loop through destruction of last context/integrator; includes context creation, CUDA compilation/initialization, velocity setup, integration, energy queries and replica summaries.
timing_scope.per_replica: Starts after context/position/velocity setup; includes integration and 100 energy queries.
timing_scope.concurrent_comparison: Measure complete same-work ensemble makespan including every replica startup/setup; preserve model, seeds and energy sampling.
timing_scope.warmup_reason: No separate warmup in brief fixed-work driver.

scoring_interface.tolerance_reason: No published energy acceptance criterion; predictions are not published validation. Exact energy-series test requires output not present in brief driver.
scoring_interface.published_performance_references: anchors.json; contextual only, no pass/fail tolerance.

budget_basis: Use supplied default budgets: 1200 s per stage except tests 900 s and evaluate 2400 s. Brief estimates minute-scale fixed-work runtime; unverified on CUDA.
runtime_guarantee_reason: No CUDA reproduction allowed; hardware and setup latency unknown.

method_configuration.proposal: Eight concurrent independent replicas via MPS on same single GPU.

unavailable_commands.reason: Brief supplies sequential driver command and hypothesis; no fixed-work concurrent implementation published there.
